# `gameplay/narrative/LifePhases.js`

> **Source:** `engine/gameplay/narrative/LifePhases.js`

LifePhases — Controls the origin sequence: birth → childhood → crisis → youth → main game. Each phase runs a sequence of events and storylets, then transitions to the next. The player watches/interacts through text during early phases, then gains full control at Youth.
